latest_release.name: Manim v0.22.1
latest_release.body:
See [our rendered changelog](https://docs.manim.community/en/stable/changelog/0.22.1-changelog.html).

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Fix `ImageMobject` rendering with Pillow 13 by @behackl in https://github.com/manimcommunity/manim/pull/5074
* Fix `OpenGLImageMobject` rendering by @behackl in https://github.com/manimcommunity/manim/pull/5081
* Fix `Line` bending when expanded from a near-zero length by @WhyTan00 in https://github.com/manimcommunity/manim/pull/5078

### Documentation 📚
* Fix doubled backslashes in raw docstrings by @ExploreMaths in https://github.com/manimcommunity/manim/pull/5063
* Warn against combining `.animate` on a group and its submobjects in one `play()` call by @Kayyz1603 in https://github.com/manimcommunity/manim/pull/5070
* Fix inheritance diagram colors ignoring the manual theme toggle by @ExploreMaths in https://github.com/manimcommunity/manim/pull/5062
* Fix doubled words in docstrings and documentation by @Tarankalsi in https://github.com/manimcommunity/manim/pull/5091

### Infrastructure & Build 🔨
* Refresh the TinyTeX CI cache monthly instead of almost daily by @behackl in https://github.com/manimcommunity/manim/pull/5096
* Make the Docker image build robust against TeX mirror failures by @behackl in https://github.com/manimcommunity/manim/pull/5095

### Code Quality & Refactoring 🧹
* Simplify errors raised by methods that require points by @Indiana-Wilson in https://github.com/manimcommunity/manim/pull/5065

### Other Changes
* Prepare new release: `v0.22.1` by @behackl in https://github.com/manimcommunity/manim/pull/5088

## New Contributors
* @Kayyz1603 made their first contribution in https://github.com/manimcommunity/manim/pull/5070
* @Indiana-Wilson made their first contribution in https://github.com/manimcommunity/manim/pull/5065
* @WhyTan00 made their first contribution in https://github.com/manimcommunity/manim/pull/5078
* @Tarankalsi made their first contribution in https://github.com/manimcommunity/manim/pull/5091

**Full Changelog**: [Compare view](https://github.com/ManimCommunity/manim/compare/v0.22.0...v0.22.1)

detail.readme_excerpt:
An animation engine for explanatory math videos

Manim is an animation engine for explanatory math videos. It's used to create precise animations programmatically, as demonstrated in the videos of [3Blue1Brown](https://www.3blue1brown.com/). > [!NOTE] > The community edition of Manim (ManimCE) is a version maintained and developed by the community. It was forked from 3b1b/manim, a tool originally created and open-sourced by Grant Sanderson, also creator of the 3Blue1Brown educational math videos. While Grant Sanderson continues to maintain his own repository, we recommend this version for its continued development, improved features, enhanced documentation, and more active community-driven maintenance. If you would like to study how Grant makes his videos, head over to his repository ([3b1b/manim](https://github.com/3b1b/manim)). ## Table of Contents: - [Installation](#installation) - [Usage](#usage) - [Documentation](#documentation) - [Docker](#docker) - [Help with Manim](#help-with-manim) - [Contributing](#contributing) - [License](#license) ## Installation > [!CAUTION] > These instructions are for the community version _only_.
